description: Defines an interface IPartitionKeyProvider for creating partition keys for grains in Cosmos DB, and provides a default implementation class DefaultPartitionKeyProvider.

classes.name: DefaultPartitionKeyProvider
classes.description: Default implementation of IPartitionKeyProvider that sanitizes the grain type to generate a partition key.

methods.name: GetPartitionKey
methods.description: Creates a partition key for the given grain type and grain ID, sanitizing the grain type.
